info.description:
## RevBridge Connect tracking service v1.0.0

Public endpoints that record email engagement:

- opens, through a transparent pixel
- clicks, with a redirect to the original link
- one-click unsubscribe (RFC 8058) and the unsubscribe link in the body

Events are written to the event outbox, which the webhook dispatcher delivers.
info.title: RevBridge Track Service API

get.description:
## Link click tracking

Public endpoint that tracks clicks on email links and redirects to the original URL.

### How it works
1. Validates the token (integrity and age)
2. Records the click in the database
3. Writes a `clicked` event to the event outbox
4. Redirects to the original URL
5. Collects the client information

### Collected data
- Clicked URL (the original link)
- Timestamp of the click
- IP address
- User agent
- Referer (if available)
- Location (when possible)

### Security
- Public route: no authentication
- The token is validated (integrity and age)
- The URL is validated before the redirect
- Rate limited

### Behavior
- Status 302: redirect to the original URL
- Status 400: URL not found in the token
- Status 404: invalid or expired token

Location.description: Original URL of the clicked link

## Email open tracking Public endpoint that tracks email opens with a transparent pixel. ### How it works 1. Returns a transparent 1x1 PNG immediately 2. In the background: validates the token, records the open in the database and writes an `opened` event to the event outbox 3. Location: country/region/city from CDN headers (e.g. CF-IPCountry), when present 4. Client information: User-Agent, IP, referer ### Collected data - Timestamp of the open - IP address - User agent - Referer (if available) - Location (when possible) ### Security - Public route: no authentication - The token is validated (integrity and age) - Rate limited ### Example: the pixel in the email HTML Use an image tag with an empty `alt` attribute (for accessibility), visually hidden: ```html ```

200.description: Transparent pixel returned. The event processing (token validation, INSERT, outbox) happens in the background; this route always returns 200, so it neither reveals whether a token is valid nor blocks the client.

## Unsubscribe tracking

Public endpoint that records an email unsubscribe and adds the address to the
suppression list automatically.

### How it works
1. Validates the token (integrity and age)
2. Records the unsubscribe in the database
3. Adds the address to the suppression list
4. Writes an `unsubscribed` event to the event outbox
5. Shows a confirmation page

### Collected data
- Unsubscribed address
- Timestamp of the unsubscribe
- IP address
- User agent
- Referer (if available)
- Location (when possible)

### Suppression list
- Automatic: the address is added automatically
- Permanent: does not expire (until removed manually)
- Type: unsubscribe
- Reason: includes the reason and the message_id

### Security
- Public route: no authentication
- The token is validated (integrity and age)
- Rate limited

### Page
- A responsive HTML page confirms the unsubscribe to the recipient

text/html.example:
Unsubscribe confirmed

You have been removed from our mailing list.
